title: triangulate
body:
## triangulate

Converts polygonal data so that every polygon and triangle strip becomes triangles and polylines become single line segments; vertices are kept. The output is vtkPolyData on the same points, with cell values copied from each parent cell. Use it before operations or exports that need triangles, such as decimate or STL output. It accepts only polygonal input: run surface first for volume data, or use pvTetrahedralize to split volume cells into tetrahedra.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The cell count grows (a quadrilateral becomes two triangles) and cell values are repeated on each piece, so per-cell counts and cell-based statistics change, while point data is unaffected.
- Schemaxis's serial native acceptance run (examples/schemaxis/extended-coverage.json) executes this operation once, on a wavelet slice; it does not check this operation's output values, so inspect the result on your own data.

Native constructor: `Triangulate`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "triangulate",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
